description: Conversation message with identity, content, time and optional actions.

howToUse: Use it for a message of a conversation with author and time: support chat, comments, an assistant.
Fill `author`, `initials` and `time`; set `side` to tell who speaks.
Your application sends and receives the messages.
alternatives: Only the bubble, without author: Bubble.
The list of messages with scroll: MessageScroller.

keyboard.action: The message does not receive focus. Its links and actions do.

examples.label: Interactive
